topic: 缝隙连接与电突触——连接素36、电耦合中间神经元与γ振荡

sources.title: Electrical synapses in the mammalian brain
key_claims_used: Cx36是哺乳动物中间神经元中的主要神经元连接蛋白
电突触是'普遍存在但被严重低估的神经回路特征'
电突触使得相邻细胞群阈值下和锋电位活动的紧密同步成为可能

sources.authors: Söhl G, Maxeiner S, Willecke K
sources.title: Expression and functions of neuronal gap junctions
key_claims_used: 神经元连接蛋白种类：Cx36、Cx45、Cx57
Pannexin 1/2 也可能参与形成电突触
利用靶向基因缺陷小鼠揭示不同connexin的功能

sources.authors: Buhl DL, Harris KD, Hormuzdi SG, Monyer H, Buzsáki G
sources.title: Selective impairment of hippocampal gamma oscillations in connexin-36 knock-out mouse in vivo
key_claims_used: Cx36 KO小鼠海马γ功率在locomotion时显著降低
θ振荡和fast ripples (140-200Hz)不受Cx36 KO影响
Cx36缝隙连接选择性支持海马γ振荡

sources.title: Beyond plasticity: the dynamic impact of electrical synapses on neural circuits
key_claims_used: 电突触是动态可调节的，而非固定导线
调节机制包括pH、磷酸化、多巴胺、活动依赖时序
电突触'削弱神经元兴奋性并改变其整合特性'

sources.title: Synchronized gamma-frequency inhibition in neocortex depends on excitatory-inhibitory interactions but not electrical synapses
key_claims_used: 新皮层γ振荡不依赖电突触（Cx36 KO vs WT无显著差异）
新皮层γ主要依赖E-I相互作用

sources.authors: Traub RD, Pais I, Bibbig A, LeBeau FEN, Buhl EH, Hormuzdi SG, Monyer H, Whittington MA
sources.title: Contrasting roles of axonal (pyramidal cell) and dendritic (interneuron) electrical coupling in the generation of neuronal network oscillations
key_claims_used: 计算模型：轴突间电耦合是γ振荡产生的必要条件
树突间电耦合（中间神经元）只起调节作用

sources.authors: Via G, Barreda Tomás FJ, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.title: Interneuronal network model of theta-nested fast oscillations predicts differential effects of heterogeneity, gap junctions and short term depression for hyperpolarizing versus shunting inhibition
key_claims_used: 缝隙连接对超极化抑制驱动的γ是必要的，对分流抑制不是
这可能解释海马vs新皮层实验差异
网络异质性和gap junction强度共同决定θ-γ嵌套振荡的稳定性

sources.authors: Ixmatlahua DJ, Vizcaíno-Escobar A, Mercado-Reyes J, Castillo PE, Flores-Hernández J, Flores G
sources.title: Neuronal glutamatergic network electrically wired with silent but activatable gap junctions
key_claims_used: 海马苔状纤维-CA3突触处存在含Cx36的沉默缝隙连接
这些连接在pH改变时被激活，形成谷氨酸能主细胞之间的电突触
化学和电突触可在同一接触位点共存

sources.authors: Kraft AW, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.title: Electrically coupled inhibitory interneurons constrain long-range connectivity of cortical networks
key_claims_used: Cx36 KO改变皮层区域间自发活动的远程同步（infra-slow band）
删除Cx36增加半球内远程反相关
局部电耦合网络间接调控全脑网络级别同步

sources.authors: Borroto-Escuela DO, Cuppini R, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.title: Understanding electrical and chemical transmission in the brain
key_claims_used: 历史回顾：化学传递vs电传递的区分
缝隙连接='神经细胞间的低电阻通道'
电突触传递快于化学传递

sources.authors: Shao LR, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL, Bhatt DL
sources.title: Antiepileptogenic and neuroprotective effect of mefloquine after experimental status epilepticus
key_claims_used: Cx36阻断剂甲氟喹在SE后具有抗癫痫发生效果
甲氟喹保护了抑制性中间神经元免于死亡
Cx36电突触在病理性癫痫同步中有作用
